notes: Preprint, self-authored by the PI (PROMISE Labs Africa); still under peer review, sample size may be revised once a final accepted version exists. N=78 used here (not the N=106 total recruited) -- Table 1 reports 106 for most characteristics, but Economy Type Assigned To (the experimental condition the demand analysis is split on) and Household Income both sum to only 78 with no accounting for the other 28, so 78 is treated as the analyzed sample.
